question: Does feeding sv_distribution the MEASURED primary position (positions_played.json, SP/RP) instead of the LISTED position change the resolved-pitcher bucket likelihood (pooled logloss), and does the role-mismatch subcohort improve?
why_audit_only: No clean resolved read exists. The lane fails on three independent grounds; per the registration ('if no clean resolved read exists the lane records AUDIT-ONLY (no ship) - honesty over reach') no gate number is manufactured and nothing ships.

1_gate_metric_is_position_invariant_by_c.finding: The registered gate metric is the resolved-pitcher BUCKET LIKELIHOOD (pooled logloss). That likelihood is p_bucket_given_fv(fv, is_pitcher) (value_framework.py:749), whose signature takes ONLY fv and is_pitcher - it does not consume a position argument at all.
1_gate_metric_is_position_invariant_by_c.consequence: The measured-vs-listed A/B delta on the gate metric is exactly 0.000 by construction: swapping the position source cannot move a probability vector that never reads position. The registered metric cannot discriminate between the two sources.
1_gate_metric_is_position_invariant_by_c.where_position_actually_enters: Position feeds ONLY the dollar layer, via _pitcher_rp_by_bucket (value_framework.py:1270) -> _effective_bucket_sv (1290): P(reliever|bucket) blends the full-SP value and the bullpen-capped RP value into the per-bucket surplus $. It changes surplus DOLLARS, never the bucket PROBABILITIES the gate scores.

dollar_layer_sensitivity_demo_fv50.note: position DOES move the $ layer materially - it is simply not what the registered likelihood metric measures

2_measured_source_structurally_absent_fo.finding: positions_played.json is a POSITION-PLAYER fielding-versatility sidecar; pitchers are skipped by construction (fielding_positions.py:78-80, 'Fetch fielding-by-position for every POSITION-PLAYER prospect ... Pitchers are skipped (no versa)').
2_measured_source_structurally_absent_fo.note: The 2 hits are a single duplicated key (adrian_hernandez, by_pos P g346/gs22 -> a reliever) plus position-players who pitched in blowouts elsewhere in the file; there is no pitcher SP/RP signal to read.

3_listed_source_carries_no_role_for_the_.finding: Even the incumbent LISTED position is handedness-only for the 2017-2019 resolved cohort, so there is no listed SP/RP role to contrast against a measured one.
3_listed_source_carries_no_role_for_the_.note: 1063/1073 resolved pitchers are tagged only by throwing hand. _pos_primary maps these to the GENERIC config base reliever mix; there is no SP/RP contrast to A/B, on either side.

analysis_actually_run.protocol: Reference computation through the engine's public functions: resolved pitchers from surplus_backtest_real._resolved_only(build_cohorts()); realized 6yr-avg WAR from backtest._realized_control_war/6; realized bucket = nearest calibrated pitcher midpoint (0.0,1.0,2.0,3.2,5.0); predicted p = value_framework.p_bucket_given_fv(fv, True); logloss_i = -log(max(p[bucket],1e-9)).
analysis_actually_run.delta_is_exact_zero_reason: p_bucket_given_fv does not read position; the two 'sources' produce identical probability vectors, so the pooled logloss is byte-identical, not merely close.

role_mismatch_subcohort.reason: a role-mismatch subcohort requires BOTH a listed role and a measured role; neither exists for pitchers here (grounds 2 and 3).

recommendation_for_future_cycles_out_of_: If the owner wants to price pitcher role from measured usage, the signal is games-started share (career_stats gamesStarted/appearances or the by_pos['P'] gs/g concept), NOT positions_played.json (which excludes pitchers). That would be a NEW measured-role source and a NEW registration; it is not the frozen positions_played A/B and is not run here. Note also that any such feature would act on the DOLLAR layer (_pitcher_rp_by_bucket), not the bucket-likelihood metric this lane was registered against - the metric itself would need reframing.
